name: ioPix
mcp: Lets an AI assistant search, look at and organize your photos, as you.

settings.name: PHOTOS_ROOT
settings.label: Photos folder
settings.hint: Where the photos are, when the library has a single album root. Empty: a folder named photos in the data folder.

settings.name: DIGIKAM_DB_TYPE
settings.label: digiKam database
settings.hint: none: no digiKam at all, ioPix keeps the library itself. sqlite: digikam4.db in the folder below. mysql: the server below.

settings.name: DIGIKAM_DB_USER
settings.label: digiKam MySQL user
settings.hint: Its password is set in ioPix under Settings › Library › digiKam database.

settings.name: DIGIKAM_DB_BACKUP
settings.label: Back up digiKam's database before destructive operations

settings.name: DIGIKAM_DB_DUMP
settings.label: Command that dumps digiKam's MySQL database
settings.hint: Used instead of mysqldump, e.g. through docker exec.

settings.name: DIGIKAM_CHECK
settings.label: How to tell that digiKam is closed
settings.hint: none: digiKam runs on another machine and cannot be seen.

settings.name: DIGIKAM_MYSQL_DATES
settings.label: Dates in a MySQL digiKam library
settings.hint: Empty: detected.

settings.name: PREWARM
settings.label: Build all grid thumbnails in the background

settings.name: CAPTIONS
settings.label: Describe every photo in a sentence

settings.name: AUTO_MODELS
settings.label: Models to download when missing
settings.hint: For example siglip2,yolox,geonames.

settings.name: BG_THREADS
settings.label: Cores a background job may use
settings.hint: Empty: half the machine.

settings.name: PREWARM_WORKERS
settings.label: Threads for thumbnails
settings.hint: Empty: the cores above.

settings.name: ANALYSIS_WORKERS
settings.label: Threads for analysis
settings.hint: Empty: the cores above.

settings.name: JOBS_PROCESS
settings.label: Run AI jobs in a process of their own

settings.name: JOBS_MEMORY_MB
settings.label: Most memory the job process may hold (MB)
settings.hint: Empty: 60% of the machine's. 0: no limit.

settings.name: MEMORY_RESERVE_MB
settings.label: Free memory the server keeps (MB)
settings.hint: Empty: 8% of the machine's.

settings.name: REINDEX_POLL
settings.label: Seconds between checks of digiKam's database

settings.name: INDEX_PATCH
settings.label: Update the search index in place after small changes

settings.name: EXIFTOOL
settings.label: exiftool to use
settings.hint: Empty: the one on the PATH.

settings.name: APP_NAME
settings.label: What it calls itself
settings.hint: The name on its pages. Empty: ioPix.

settings.name: WRITE_FILES
settings.label: Write metadata into the picture files
settings.hint: Tags, names and dates go into the files themselves as well, not only into the sidecars.

settings.name: DIGIKAM_SYNC
settings.label: Read and write digiKam's database
settings.hint: Off: ioPix works from its own copy of the library and never opens digiKam's database.

settings.name: FILE_SCANNER
settings.label: Watch the album folders
settings.hint: Find files added, changed or removed outside ioPix. Empty: on where there is no digiKam, since nothing else finds new photos.

settings.name: SEARCH_MODEL
settings.label: Model behind search
settings.hint: clip, siglip2 or jinaclip; Settings › Search picks one of the models installed here.

settings.name: FACE_DETECTOR
settings.label: Model that finds faces
settings.hint: Empty: the first one installed. Settings › People picks one.

settings.name: OBJECT_MODEL
settings.label: Model that names what is in a photo
settings.hint: Empty: the first one installed.

settings.name: CAPTION_MODEL
settings.label: Model that describes a photo
settings.hint: Empty: the first one installed.

settings.name: FACE_VECTORS
settings.label: Model that tells faces apart
settings.hint: Empty: the first one installed. A change rebuilds the stored vectors.

settings.name: SPEECH_MODEL
settings.label: Model that reads speech in videos
settings.hint: Empty: the first one installed.

settings.name: NEAR_DUPS_LEVEL
settings.label: How alike near duplicates must be

settings.name: IMPORT_LAYOUT
settings.label: Folder layout imports go into
settings.hint: Empty: the first layout ioPix offers.

settings.name: ALBUM_ROOTS
settings.label: Where digiKam's album roots are here
settings.hint: Set in Settings › Library when the folders are mounted somewhere else than digiKam recorded.

settings.name: EDIT_TEMPLATES
settings.label: Edit templates
settings.hint: The owner name and contact details the Edit panel offers, set in Settings › Editing.

ask.name: PHOTOS_ROOT
ask.question: ioPix: the folder with the photos (empty: a new, empty one in the data folder)

ask.name: DIGIKAM_DB_DIR
ask.question: ioPix: the folder with digiKam's digikam4.db (empty: no digiKam, ioPix keeps the library itself)
